messages:
Ana C: Drafting 'Adoption Flow' checklist for first 30 days. Goal: lower renewal risk by ensuring fast UX via prefill, warmup, batching, streaming. TL;DR below. :seedling:

Sam G: Add low-DAU branch (<10% daily active) and a throttled kill-switch for big prefetches.

Ana C: Checklist:
- Prefill top 5 intents into prefix cache (TTL=24h).
- Warmup: stagger to 50 reqs/min per tenant over first 24h.
- Client cap: batch max 4 requests / 32 tokens.
- Streaming fallback when p50 latency > 500ms.
- Telemetry: adoption score + sampled responses + regression alerts.
- Handoff alerts at day 14 and day 28 for adoption_score < 0.15.

Jordan (SE): Warmup runner for Dedicated/Private (run from separate control host):
for i in {1..50}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"xlarge-v1","input":"prefill:customer_top_utterances"}' &
  sleep 1
done
Notes: keep concurrency low, spread across AZs, respect per-tenant throttle flag.

Maria P: I'll make a 1-pager + CSM outreach email. Ops: set alert for adoption_score < 0.15 at day14.

Sam G: For at-risk tenants: daily QA sampling (5 responses/day), auto-rollback if eval quality drops >5%, and short burst prefetch to keep UX while investigating.

Ana C: Add in-app 3-question survey at day7: output ok? (y/n), latency issues? (y/n), blockers? (free text). Keep tiny.
